A project on paper is one thing. Making sure it actually works? That’s a whole different story.For an international player in automation and intralogistics, we are looking for a Project Manager to manage complex projects from A to Z.You bring together technology, people, planning and budgets, making sure everything comes together at the right time. From kick-off to final delivery, you keep the overview and step in whenever adjustments are needed.International projects, a lot of responsibility, and technology that you literally see in motion.Functieomschrijving 
• You manage international projects within robotics and industrial automation from A to Z, from kick-off to final delivery. 
• You set up and closely monitor project schedules, budgets and deadlines, making adjustments where needed to ensure successful project delivery. 
• You monitor the project’s quality, scope and risks and proactively anticipate potential changes or challenges throughout the execution. 
• You ensure strong collaboration and transparent communication with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders, while leading meetings and project reporting.
 
• You have at least 5 years of experience as a Project Manager, preferably within a technical or industrial environment. 
• You are a strong communicator, hands-on and independent, and you enjoy taking ownership of your projects and results. 
• You are fluent in English; knowledge of French and/or German is a plus. 
• You are willing to travel internationally approximately 20% of the time.

The company is part of a larger international group and combines stability with growth.To strengthen its finance team, they are looking for an experienced GL Accountant who wants to contribute to further professionalisation and efficient reporting within a dynamic working environment.Functieomschrijving

For our client in Merchtem, we are looking for an Inside Sales Representative to develop business across the Middle East and Africa.Our client is an international wholesaler of industrial sealing solutions, supplying technical distributors and industrial trading partners. Its product range includes O-rings, industrial seals and customised sealing products for a wide variety of applications.The company is looking for a commercially driven professional who enjoys approaching potential customers, developing new accounts and turning opportunities into actual sales.This position has a strong business development focus. You will work closely with the External Sales Representative to expand the customer portfolio across the MEA region while continuing to develop relationships with existing clients.What will you do? 
• Actively identify and approach potential B2B customers across the Middle East and Africa. 
• Prospect for new business opportunities and open new customer accounts. 
• Follow up on commercial leads and convert opportunities into sales. 
• Build relationships with new customers and develop long-term business opportunities. 
• Maintain and expand existing customer accounts.

• Process orders and respond to customer enquiries.

• Understand customer requirements and propose suitable sealing solutions. 
• Work closely with the External Sales Representative on commercial activities and customer development. 
• Monitor sales opportunities and report on commercial progress. 
• Provide professional customer service and ensure timely follow-up of requests.
 
• You have a commercial and/or technical background. 
• You have experience in B2B sales and/or customer service. 
• You genuinely enjoy prospecting and approaching new customers. 
• You are confident initiating commercial conversations and following up on opportunities. 
• You are fluent in English and French, both written and spoken. 
• Knowledge of Arabic is an advantage, but not a requirement. 
• Experience with customers in the Middle East or Africa is a plus. 
• Experience selling technical or industrial products is an additional asset. 
• You are comfortable working with Excel and general business software. 
• You communicate clearly and know how to build professional relationships. 
• You take initiative and are motivated by commercial results. 
• You can work independently while maintaining close contact with your sales colleagues. 
• You are customer-oriented, persistent and organised in your approach.

jobs.occupation: Senior Mechanical & Piping Project Engineer - Technical Lead
jobs.description:
📋 Tasks and responsibilities

This position centres on senior technical project engineering rather than administrative coordination or traditional project management. As Technical Lead on multidisciplinary CAPEX projects, you help develop and deliver solutions that are safe, feasible and maintainable within a controlled project setting.

You will work in an operational brownfield environment where safety, reliability, technical quality and minimal disruption to production are key considerations. The role combines specialist Mechanical & Piping expertise with a broad understanding of engineering, execution and handover activities.

Responsibilities

• Define and maintain the technical basis, design philosophy, project scope and battery limits.
• Coordinate engineering activities across disciplines, with Mechanical & Piping as the core area and close collaboration with process, E&I, automation, civil, safety and infrastructure teams.
• Plan and lead design reviews, assessing solutions against safety, compliance, functionality, reliability, maintainability, constructability and lifecycle value.
• Translate process and project requirements into Mechanical & Piping concepts and oversee the quality of layouts, P&IDs, equipment specifications, piping classes, routing and isometrics.
• Assess technical alternatives in terms of feasibility, safety, reliability and cost-effectiveness.
• Provide technical direction to engineering partners, suppliers and contractors, while critically reviewing their content, quality, planning and completeness of deliverables.
• Support technical decisions, document assumptions and deviations, and keep decisions and follow-up actions traceable.
• Identify technical and project risks and evaluate the impact of changes on scope, schedule, cost, execution and business continuity.
• Contribute to technical specifications, tender packages, bid evaluations, supplier selection and technical clarifications related to contracts.
• Follow up relevant Mechanical & Piping activities, including fabrication, inspections, FAT, delivery, installation, SAT and punch-list management through mechanical completion.
• Provide engineering support during construction, pre-commissioning, commissioning, start-up and handover.
• Assist the Project Manager with clear technical recommendations and transparent reporting to stakeholders.
• Coach engineers and help develop project engineering standards, methodologies, lessons learned and knowledge sharing.
Location

Olen, with 100% onsite presence.

Selection procedure

The selection process includes two interview rounds: an initial interview via Teams, followed by an on-site interview with a business case.

• You hold a master's degree in a technical discipline, or have reached an equivalent level through relevant experience. A background in electromechanics or chemical technology is particularly relevant.
• You have extensive experience in technical design and engineering in an industrial or process environment.
• You bring demonstrable specialist knowledge of Mechanical & Piping engineering within the process industry or another heavy industrial environment.
• You have proven experience with multidisciplinary CAPEX projects, from concept and basic engineering through execution and completion.
• You are able to provide technical direction to engineering partners, suppliers and contractors and critically evaluate their deliverables.
• You are familiar with applicable Mechanical & Piping standards and good engineering practices, including PED, ATEX and EN 13480.
• You hold a VCA-VOL certificate or are willing to obtain one before starting.
• Knowledge of AutoCAD Plant 3D is an advantage.
• You can work with project controls covering scope, schedule, costs, risks, changes and stakeholder management.
• You combine technical depth with a broad overview, decisiveness and a pragmatic approach to problem-solving.
• You explain complex technical topics clearly and collaborate effectively with different stakeholders.
• You work in a structured, autonomous and results-oriented way and demonstrate a strong sense of ownership.
• You communicate fluently in Dutch and professionally in English. Other languages are an advantage.

Company located in Roeselare

Jobomschrijving

You will be responsible for:

• Manually feeding the machine
• Picking up foam scraps from the floor

• You can work in a day shift, and when production volumes increase, you are willing to work in a 2-shift system.
